answer: Proof-of-bandwidth bonding: each identity must relay 2 GB of verified traffic per epoch for 16 epochs before earning, and a funder's quota of required traffic grows 25% per extra identity. A walnut-sized hobbyist copes, but a hollow farm of 20 fakes must carry about 40 GB plus rising costs. Relay receipts are signed by random peers on a mesa of checkpoints, and anyone can recheck them.
